message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have resent my message to Brad in the previous session, but he has still not responded. We are now in session 7, and the deadline is approaching. I need to take a more proactive approach. As I planned, I will now suggest a specific time from my list and ask him to check it. This is less efficient than getting the full list of his partners' availability, but it's better than waiting and doing nothing.

I will select the first available time slot from my list, which is Monday at 9:00 AM, and ask him to check if Elena and David are free at that time. This will hopefully get the conversation moving again. I will then end my session to give him a chance to respond.
